title: dial params
description: Connects to a remote kamune server. Which fields are required depends on transport: addr for tcp and udp, relay_addr and token for relay, broker_addr and p2p_token for p2p, and direct_peer_addr for direct-p2p. Over a relay, connecting to the relay and the relay handshake are limited to 15 seconds.

addr.description: Server address (e.g. "127.0.0.1:9000"). Required for tcp and udp, where an empty addr fails with addr_required. Ignored for relay, p2p and direct-p2p.

transport.description: Transport protocol. Defaults to "tcp" when empty or absent. Any other value fails with invalid_transport.

relay_addr.description: Relay server address, host:port with an optional scheme: wss:// (the default), tls://, ws:// or tcp://. A trailing ?insecure=true turns off TLS certificate checks. ws://, tcp:// and ?insecure=true let an on-path attacker read the relay password and tokens, and are logged as a warning. Required when transport is "relay".

token.description: Hex-encoded relay token. Required when transport is "relay".

name.description: Client display name. Defaults to a fingerprint pseudonym, which incognito mode always uses.

broker_addr.description: UDP host:port of the broker. Required when transport is "p2p".

peer_pub_b64.description: Base64-encoded public key of the target peer. Not used by dial.

p2p_token.description: Hex-encoded P2P token from the server: 32 hex characters for a token the broker assigned, 64 for a static token. Required when transport is "p2p", where any other value fails with invalid_p2p_token. The dial waits at most 30 seconds for the broker to match it with the server.

direct_peer_addr.description: UDP host:port of the peer. Required when transport is "direct-p2p".
